outcome: Fetal fraction in cell-free DNA test
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent cell-free DNA testing in the first and second trimester and were subsequently diagnosed with placenta previa or placenta accreta spectrum, compared to a control group with a history of uncomplicated C-section
finding: There was no significant difference in fetal fraction in cell-free DNA tests between pregnant women with placenta previa or placenta accreta spectrum and a control group.
